user.title: Connect to Mercadona
user.description:
Mercadona does not allow automated sign-in: its login requires a reCAPTCHA that can only be solved in a browser or in their app. So this asks for a **session token** you extract once, instead of a username and password. The integration renews it on its own from then on.

**Option A — from the browser (no root)**

1. Sign in at `tienda.mercadona.es`.
2. Open developer tools (F12) → **Network** tab.
3. Sign out and back in: a request to `api/auth/tokens/` will appear.
4. Copy the `refresh_token` value from its response.

**Option B — from the Android app (needs root)**

The app stores the session in `shared_prefs`, under the `userJson` key:

```
adb shell "su -c 'cat /data/data/es.mercadona.tienda/shared_prefs/es.mercadona.tienda_preferences.xml'"
```

Inside that JSON, the value is at `auth.refresh_token`.

Treat the token like a password: it grants full access to the account. It lasts months and renews itself, so this is a one-off.

data_description.refresh_token: The refresh_token value you copied. It is long and starts with 'eyJ'.
data_description.warehouse: Optional and rarely needed: with a session in place, Mercadona already knows which warehouse to serve. Only use it to force a different one, e.g. 'mad1'.
data_description.postal_code: Optional. Taken from your account if left empty.

keep.title: Add products by voice (optional)
keep.description:
A Google speaker cannot send free text to Home Assistant. When you say *"Hey Google, add toilet paper to my shopping list"*, all it does is write it into a **Google Keep** list.

This integration uses that list as a **mailbox**: it reads it every few seconds, puts the product in your Mercadona cart and **deletes the entry from Keep**. You never look at Keep; your list is still the cart.

Reading it needs a Google *master token*, obtained with `gpsoauth`:

1. In an incognito window, open `accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup` and sign in with the speakers' account.
2. Accept the terms shown. The page will go blank: that is expected.
3. Developer tools → **Application → Cookies** → copy the `oauth_token` cookie.
4. Exchange it using the `tools/keep_setup.py` script in the repository.

If you would rather not use voice, leave both fields empty: the panel and entities work all the same.

Reconfiguring is mostly for turning voice on after trying everything else. Leave the fields empty to disable voice.

data_description.gkeep_email: The account your speakers talk to. It can be a secondary account with the list shared.
data_description.gkeep_master_token: Starts with 'aas_et/'. It grants broad access to that Google account: keep it safe.

keep_list.title: Which one is your shopping list?
keep_list.description:
These are the lists found in Keep, with how many unchecked items each one has.

Pick the one the Assistant fills. Choose carefully: on startup, whatever is unchecked in that list will be added to the cart.

reauth_confirm.title: The Mercadona session expired
reauth_confirm.description:
The token stopped working. This usually happens after changing your Mercadona password, signing out everywhere, or months without use.

Extract a new one the same way as the first time and paste it here.

error.token_rechazado: Mercadona rejected the token. Check you copied it whole and that it is the refresh_token, not the access_token.
error.sin_conexion: Could not reach Mercadona. Check your connection and try again.
error.keep_rechazado: Google rejected those credentials. The master token must start with 'aas_et/' and belong to the account given.
error.keep_sin_listas: That account has no lists in Keep. Create one, or say something to your speaker so it creates it, and try again.

abort.already_configured: That Mercadona account is already configured.

data.poll_seconds: How often the voice mailbox is checked, in seconds

data_description.poll_seconds: At 15 seconds, whatever you dictate shows up in the cart almost immediately.
data_description.max_batch: Stops a list with accumulated history from dumping everything into the cart at once. The rest comes in on later polls.
